content: Akʉmara kɨkarorekana ichɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ kɨkʉrʉ kwisaarʉ. Kwarɨ nʉ ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ aakundikiriibhwɨ iryʉbha, nu umwɨri gwarɨ guri iyaasɨ wa amagʉrʉ gaazɨ. Na kumutwɨ gwazɨ aarɨ nɨ ɨkɨrʉngʉ cha zenzota ikumi ni ibhɨrɨ.
Ʉmʉkari wuyo aarɨ aritʉhirɨ, hanʉ aaraarirɨ kwitʉʉranʼya ʉbhʉsʉngʉ bhʉkamurya, akarɨra.
Akʉmara kɨkarorekana ichɨrɨkɨnʼyʉ ɨkɨndɨ kwisaarʉ. Rora, gwareho ogozoka gʉkʉrʉ gubhiriiri, ryarɨ ni imitwɨ muhungatɨ na zehembe ikumi, ni imitwɨ jʉsi jarɨ nɨ ɨbhɨrʉngʉ.

Ʉmʉkɨra gwaryo gʉkakwesa yɨmwɨ yi isatʉ ya zenzota za kwisaarʉ, na kozerekera kʉʉsɨ. Ogozoka guyo gukiimɨɨrɨra mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwʉ ʉmʉkari wʉnʉ aarɨ haguhɨ kwitʉʉranʼya, korereke hanʉ akwitʉʉranʼya, gʉmɨrɨ umwana waazɨ.
Akʉmara ʉmʉkari akiibhʉra umwana wi ikisubhɨ, umwana wuyo arakangata ibhyarʉ bhyʉsi kuhimbʉ yi ichʉma. Umwana wuyo akasaakurwa, akahirwa kwa Mungu kukitumbɨ chazɨ chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi.
Ʉmʉkari wuyo akangʼosera kʉkɨbhara, ahagero hanʉ haakʉrirwɨ na Mungu, korereke iyo amutugɨ kwa sikʉ kɨkwɨ kɨmwɨ na magana abhɨrɨ na merongo ɨsaasabha.
Neho rɨkatanga riihɨ mwisaarʉ. Maraika ʉmʉkʉrʉ, wʉnʉ akubhirikirwa Mikaɨri, hamwɨmwɨ na bhamaraika bhaazɨ, bhakiitana no ogozoka na bhamaraika bhaagwɨ.
Nawe ogozoka na bhamaraika bhaagwɨ bhakahizwa na bhakaheebhwa kurwa mwisaarʉ.
Ogozoka guyo gwɨ ɨkarɨ gʉrabhirikirwa Ibhiriisi hamwɨ Shɨtaani, rɨnʉ rɨhaakangirirya ɨɨsɨ yʉʉsi, rɨkarekerwa kuhika kʉʉsɨ hamwɨmwɨ na bhamaraika bhaagwɨ.
Akʉmara nikiigwa riraka ikʉrʉ kurwa mwisaarʉ rɨrabhuga,

content.text: na zinguru nʉ ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu wɨɨtʉ
kʉ kʉbha arɨkɨɨrwɨ haasɨ ʉmʉgambi wa abhiisirirya abhakɨndichɨtʉ,
wʉnʉ akʉbhagamba mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu wɨɨtʉ ubhutikʉ nu umwise.
Nangʉ abhakɨndichɨtʉ bhahizirɨ kʉmasaahɨ gɨ Ɨkɨngʼʉndu cha Mungu,
na kʉngʼana yo obhomenyeekererya bhʉnʉ bhaabhuruushiryɨ,
kʉ kʉbha bhatarʉʉzɨ ubhwera bhu ubhwikari bhwabhʉ,
anʉ ʉbhʉrʉrʉ kʉ kʉbha amɨnyirɨ zisikʉ zaazɨ zɨsaagirɨ suuhu.”

content: Hanʉ ogozoka gwarʉʉzɨ gʉtaashibhwɨ kʉʉsɨ, gʉkatuna ʉmʉkari wurya itʉʉrɨɨnʼyɨ umwana wi ikisubhɨ.
Nawe ʉmʉkari wuyo akahaabhwa amapapa abhɨrɨ ncha gɨ ɨmatʉʉnyi ɨkʉrʉ, korereke abhururukɨ ajɨ kʉkɨbhara, kore no ogozoka. Iyo aratugwa kwa sikʉ kɨkwɨ kɨmwɨ na magana abhɨrɨ na merongo ɨsaasabha.
Ogozoka gʉkahurucha amanzi maaru nchɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ kurwa mumunywa gwaryo, korereke ʉmʉkari wuyo agegwe nɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ kiyo.
Nawe ɨɨsɨ ɨkasakirya ʉmʉkari wuyo, ikiiyigʉra nchu umunywa, ɨkamɨra amanzi gɨ ɨkɨtaarʉ ganʉ gaahurukirɨ kurwa mumunywa gwo ogozoka.

Ogozoka gukiigatanɨra bhʉkʉngʼu ʉmʉkari wuyo, gʉkarweho, gʉkaja kokora riihɨ na abhaana bhʉ ʉmʉkari wuyo bhanʉ bhasaagirɨ. Abhaana bhayo, nɨ‑bhanʉ bhakwigwa amaswaja ga Mungu na kʉbha no obhomenyeekererya bhwa Yɨɨsu.
Mmbe, ogozoka gukiimɨɨrɨra rusizʉ wɨ ɨnyanza.
